title: The Letters for the Upstairs Neighbor
youtube_title: The Letters for the Upstairs Neighbor | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness leaves a person with their dignity intact.
summary: At a school hallway of pegs, stools, and music stands, a stack of letters for the upstairs neighbor is awkward for one person. Sable notices Neighbor Sami struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
